2  CCC No.200168 of 2023  ORDER
The complainant was the absolute owner of land in Sy No.128 measuring 14 acres 16 guntas [including 10 guntas of Phut Kharab-A land] of Araladinni Village, Nidagundi Yaluk, Vijayapura District.

The complainant has filed his writ petition in W.P.No.201384/2022 contending that though only 13 acres 12 guntas was acquired in the year 1968 for the purpose of Almatti Dam - Upper Krishna Project and compensation is paid for this extent, the respondents have utilized the remaining 1 acre 4 guntas of land [including 10 guntas of Phut Kharab-A land] without acquisition.
In fact, the complainant had earlier filed writ petition in W.P.No.8262/2019 which is disposed of on 06.01.2020 directing the authorities to consider the representation.

2. The subject writ petition in W.P.No.201384/2022 is disposed of quashing Endorsement dated 14.06.2021, a result of the consideration as directed by the writ Court on 06.01.2020 and issuing directions as follows:
NC: 2024:KHC-K:1550-DB

A mandamus is issued directing the respondent No.2 to proceed with the notification under Section 11(1) of the Act of 2013 and complete the said process of acquisition within a period of 60 days from the date of receipt of copy of this order, failing which, the acquisition would have to be held to have lapsed.

As regards, balance 10 guntas of land, if the State were not wanting to acquire the same,
the possession of the same would have to be handed back to the petitioner.

If the State were wanting to acquire the said land, necessary notification to be issued as per Section 11(1) of the Act of 2013 within 4 weeks of the receipt of a copy of this order and acquisition completed in accordance with law, in the time frame given there under 3.

During the pendency of these proceedings, it is brought on record that the respondents though initially preferred a review petition in R.P.FR.No.200012/2024,
because it is ascertained that an additional extent of 34 guntas is acquired earlier and compensation paid they have now conducted a survey, and

after this survey notification under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and NC: 2024:KHC-K:1550-DB Resettlement Act, 2013 is also issued for acquisition of 10 guntas of land.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Smt. Ratna N. Shivayogimath, the learned counsel for the complainant, submits for the first time before this Court that an extent of 34 guntas is acquired and compensation paid but the complainant has not received compensation.

However,
that is a matter to be examined if there are appropriate proceedings at the instance of the complainant.

Perhaps it would be in the fitness of things that upon culmination of the notification now issued for acquisition of 10 guntas of land, the compensation is Prahallad vs Rajendra Kumar Kataria And Ors on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142897368/
3 paid to the complainant, and this complaint must fail.
